title: 2_4_Nates_Revenge

quiz.question: What does the word 'abhor' mean?
options: To fall asleep because something is super boring.

quiz.question: What does the word 'elicit' mean?
options: A beast with an elephant head on a smaller elephant's body.

quiz.question: If an object travels at 3 feet per second, how many feet does it travel in one hour?
quiz.question_short: 3 feet per second. How many feet in an hour?
options: Trick question! Objects don't have 3 feet! Burned!

quiz.question: Which of the following is a factor of the sum of 15 + 45?
quiz.question_short: A factor of the sum of 15 + 45?

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
quiz.question_short: NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
options: Me! I am not a multiple of 9 + 3!

quiz.question: If n + 1 = 25, what is the value of 3n + 3?
A number is divided by 4. The result is divided by 4, which equals 2. What was the original number?
quiz.question_short: Number divided by 4. Result divided by 4 to get 2. Original number?
options: I'm too smart to answer such easy questions.

quiz.question: What does the word 'fathom' mean?
options: To get a question wrong in a quiz.

quiz.question: What does the word 'gratuitous' mean?
options: Spitting everywhere like a camel. In short, not cool.

quiz.question: What does the word 'hackneyed' mean?
options: We couldn't think of anything for this... Wink. Wink.

quiz.question: What does the word 'iconoclast' mean?
options: One who can transform into a robot.
One who is really good with a computer.

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
What do you think of Nate?
Have you ever played through a sports injury?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Maybe I just don't want to get to know you, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Too bad. I was just about to tell you my favorite passage.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And why would I care about that?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're not even curious? I have it right here, on my phone's notepad app.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... Fine! If I look at it, will you leave me alone?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whatever you say, $ALLISON.
Nate sits up close to $ALLISON and shows her his phone. She reads the passage.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: 'Human speech is like a cracked kettle on which we tap crude rhythms for bears to dance to, while we long to make music that will melt the stars.'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's actually... Really beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I knew you were the type of person who appreciates the power of language.
Just then, Nate's phone makes a strange sound.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My cue to leave. Nice talking with you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It was a `surprising` conversation.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#3b78e2][i]surprising[/i][/color] conversation.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, I'm full of surprises.
Nate gets up and heads down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I admit, despite everything Madame Bovary does... I can't help but feel sorry for her.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Exactly. And maybe if you just heard `me` out, you'd realize I'm not such a bad guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly. And maybe if you just heard [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] out, you'd realize I'm not such a bad guy!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I highly doubt that.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So Madame Bovary gets a free pass, but not me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Madame Bovary didn't mess with my friends!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's hardly a consistent code of ethics. What would Immanuel Kant say about that?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How did you know I'm also reading Kant?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm a guy who pays attention to things.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Emma Bovary completely abandons her duties as a wife and mother...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And you `sympathize` with her?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you [color=#3b78e2][i]sympathize[/i][/color] with her?!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Think about it. She moves out to the country and realizes her husband is basically a totally incompetent doctor.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So then she's trapped in the middle of nowhere with an idiot to keep her company.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's still no excuse for her behavior!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Okay... Maybe you have a point.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There's no 'maybe' about it!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But at least Madame Bovary got to plead her case to you...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You haven't even heard my story.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But if you `do` need help...
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] need help...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll know who to ask.
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
In the meantime, out in the hallway, $ALLISON sits quietly, reading a book.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: 'To attain her ends, Madame Bovary had to oust them all, and she even succeeded...'

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No matter how lost I feel, a good book always soothes me...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What're you reading there, $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nate? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Just on my way to football practice... Now it's your turn to answer my question.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's 'Madame Bovary.' I'm sure you haven't read it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Easy there! Why the hostility?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know all about you Nate... How you tried to mess with Spencer's Steelman exam...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And how you tried to steal Owen's girlfriend last year!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I admit I've made a few mistakes, but it sounds like you've only heard one side of the story.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Exactly. My friends' side!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good thing Gustave Flaubert didn't share your perspective...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Gustave Flaubert?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You know. The writer of 'Madame Bovary.' The book you're reading.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know who Flaubert is! What's your point?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, Flaubert was an early pioneer of a writing style called 'Free Indirect Discourse.'

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Which, basically means that the point of view jumps in and out of characters' heads at a moment's notice!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That is... Correct.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And in the book, even though Madame Bovary cheats on her husband and ruins her family...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You can't help but sympathize with her, thanks to all the time you spent in her head.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually...

options.label: I have no sympathy for Madame Bovary.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who was that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No one.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You get a lot of texts from 'no one'?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Almost as many as I get from my buddy 'Back Off' and my cousin 'None of Your Business'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like you've got all kinds of new friends!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe you're better off hanging out with `them.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you're better off hanging out with [color=#e23b3b][i]them.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Or maybe you could just let it go and stop asking me about it?
Spencer takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sorry, bro. It's not my business.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... Uh... I never got to ask about your date with Maria.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Maria?
He looks down at his phone... Then sets it aside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, Maria. She seems... Hot?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah. Hot. And kind of mean.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like she's just your type.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: More like a pale imitation of my type.
He looks over at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know you're never supposed to say this to a girl...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But Paige `is` cute when she's angry.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Paige [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] cute when she's angry.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. I guess I can see that. Sam had a cute angry face...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I like to see $ALLISON happy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good call. I feel the same way about Paige. Of course, she's basically `never` happy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Good call. I feel the same way about Paige. Of course, she's basically [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] happy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In a way, making her smile is even more fun because it's so hard.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's like Ninja Gear 4! That game is awesome `because` it's so impossible.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like Ninja Gear 4! That game is awesome [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] it's so impossible.

nodes.text: Owen's phone beeps again, and he frowns.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for distracting me from this other stuff I'm dealing with.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No sweat.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Okay... Let's start with vocab...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually... My English grade is up to a 'B+'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Any chance you could help me with my U.S. history?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did... Did someone just say U.S. history?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's honestly not my strongest subject. What time period are you studying?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The Revolutionary War.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Revolutionary War?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hmmm... I guess I know a little bit about several of the battles.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I think I'm supposed to study the `founding fathers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I think I'm supposed to study the [color=#e23b3b][i]founding fathers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I can't take it any more!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I can't take it any more![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Spencer, buddy, pal! You've got to let me tutor you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think I'm doing just fine with $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But my knowledge of Paul Revere alone would fill a dozen essays!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I said `I'm doing fine with $ALLISON!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm doing fine with $ALLISON![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, Erik may be a better fit in this case.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I could use a little time to myself anyway, to be honest...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON, wait.
$ALLISON makes a beeline for the door and heads out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks for nothing, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait a tick! Are you saying you were trying to get some alone time with $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Yes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry to let you down, good buddy! This is just like when I brought Owen tap water instead of bottled water. A real blunder!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah. It's my own fault, Erickson. You're cool.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So... `Paul Revere?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So... [color=#e23b3b][i]Paul Revere?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe later, E. I'm not in the mood to study right now.
Spencer walks away from Erik and takes a seat next to Owen on a nearby couch.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice scowl, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks. Been working on it all day.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's with you? You sad about Paige or something?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nah. I mean, sort of...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's actually... It's something I need to deal with on my own.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Someone giving you trouble? Need me to bust some heads?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, hopefully not.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How's the leg, by the way?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stupid bone stings like fire whenever I put weight on it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You're out for Friday's game?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's not what I said.
Just then, Owen's cell phone beeps. Owen checks the incoming text.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cameron is just insecure!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's not the first word I'd use to describe him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Think about it... It's not like he's `that` much more experienced than you right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Think about it... It's not like he's [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] much more experienced than you right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, how many people has he even dated?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Dozens?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: By the time Cameron was my age, he'd already kissed six girls, gone to dances with four, and had two summer flings!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's... A lot.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I know! How am I supposed to ever catch up with him?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure you `want` to catch up with him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to catch up with him?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't know. It's frankly confusing! And I'm not accustomed to being confused!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But one thing I `do` know is that thinking about Cameron's dating history isn't cheering me up!
nodes.text_bbcode: But one thing I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] know is that thinking about Cameron's dating history isn't cheering me up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well `sorry` for trying to be nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well [color=#e23b3b][i]sorry[/i][/color] for trying to be nice!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Let's just forget this conversation and start your tutoring, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A month ago you'd never even been on a date, right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Not to mention solved a crime, made five new friends, or eaten my Gridiron Beef-Splosion on Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose I have had a lot of new experiences lately.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Definitely!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks, Spencer. You always know how to cheer me up.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I do?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You do.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Now... That's enough of me moping around. Let's start your lesson.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Very well. Time to hit the studies, I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean... 'Hit the books'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: My... Apologies. I confess I haven't been sleeping too well lately.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So Cameron `did` mess with your head!
nodes.text_bbcode: So Cameron [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] mess with your head!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron acted the perfect gentleman...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But when he... Ended things, he said something that stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: He said I was... Young. Inexperienced.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Those aren't bad things.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How would you feel if someone you `liked` made you feel like a child?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How would you feel if someone you [color=#3b78e2][i]liked[/i][/color] made you feel like a child?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not good!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, then you know how `I` feel.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, then you know how [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] feel.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're no kid, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm serious. Cameron only said that because...

options.label: He hasn't seen how much you've grown!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cameron needed a little punishment. I provided it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hardly see how it's your place to dispense vigilante justice on my behalf.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm your friend. That means I look out for you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron didn't do anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes he did! He made you cry! That's as wrong as it gets!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Look, Spencer... It's sweet that you want to stand up for me and all...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I've always been able to look out for myself, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. I guess you `did` judo-toss Veronica your first week here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. I guess you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] judo-toss Veronica your first week here.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Exactly. Honestly, you're one of my best friends here...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But if we're going to stay friends you have to promise not to pick any more fights on my behalf.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Deal, Red. I won't punch anyone else...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Unless you ask me to.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Do you actually expect me to believe that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's true!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: In that case, what were you fighting about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guy stuff!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What kind of 'guy stuff'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He, uh, doesn't think 'The Zombie Dead' is a good show.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And I think it `is` a good show!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I think it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good show!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Even if I believed that transparent lie, it still wouldn't be a good excuse to pick a fight!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Listen. You're one of my best friends here...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But if we're going to stay `friends` you have to promise not to pick any more fights on my behalf.
nodes.text_bbcode: But if we're going to stay [color=#3b78e2][i]friends[/i][/color] you have to promise not to pick any more fights on my behalf.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's all settled then.
Just then, $ALLISON walks into the room. Spencer and Kimi go totally silent.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Am I interrupting something?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was just going... Over there!
Kimi walks over to a nearby table, leaving Spencer and $ALLISON alone.
In the meantime, Erik, Owen, and Paige settle into various nooks around the room...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Time to read over the playbook for Friday's game...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Time to repaint my nails jet black!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Time to practice pouring water from one cup to another!
$ALLISON takes out her books.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you ready for your tutoring session?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yep!
$ALLISON and Spencer sit down at a table.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Before we get started... I feel obliged to mention the rumors of your recent fight with Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah! The fight!

options.label: It had nothing to do with you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean 'too soon' for you?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm waiting for the right time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Right. Because that worked out `so well` for you before!
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. Because that worked out [color=#3b78e2][i]so well[/i][/color] for you before!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop trying to rush me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Someone` around here needs to have a sense of urgency!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Someone[/i][/color] around here needs to have a sense of urgency!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How are you going to feel if you drag your feet...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And then some other guys swoops in and steals $ALLISON's heart?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not good!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So I guess we're in agreement!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess so!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cameron broke $ALLISON's heart broken at Homecoming.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's all sad and vulnerable...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What kind of guy would I be if I asked her out now?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That is `so` romantic. I love the `yearning!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] romantic. I love the [color=#3b78e2][i]yearning![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Yearning'?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: OMG, Spencer, this is like straight out of a Victorian novel!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's too bad our high school doesn't have a misty heath for you to wander...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not 'yearning!' I'm just waiting for the right time.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: If you say so...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, thanks for the encouragement. I guess.
Spencer's leg throbs with pain.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't you dare try to help me up!
Spencer pulls himself up onto a bench and sits down, his leg still aching.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Listen, man... $ALLISON is a great girl...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Too good a girl for me, in fact.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You've got that right.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm sorry she got hurt... But better it happened now than a few months down the road.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Come on, Cameron... Let's get out of here.
The swimmers head to the showers.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Too bad about Cameron and $ALLISON, buddy. He's a hard act to follow.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Time to shut your pie hole. Or my fist is going to 'follow' into your face!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Touch-y. You've got a real anger problem, Spencer. You'd better get that under control before you get yourself hurt...
Nate walks away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You okay, Spencer?
Spencer's leg throbs with pain from his fall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm fine.
The next day, in detention... Spencer hobbles through the door on his crutches.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There you are!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Where'd you come from?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've been wanting to talk to you since yesterday! I sent you like a thousand texts!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do I look like a guy who `texts?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do I look like a guy who [color=#e23b3b][i]texts?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Come on, sourpuss! Spill! Everyone says you and Cameron were fighting over $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `wish` I could get two guys to fight over me. `Soooo hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]wish[/i][/color] I could get two guys to fight over me. [color=#3b78e2][i]Soooo hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Well, it's not as awesome as it sounds.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... Did anyone mention the fight to $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Probably!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Great... What am I supposed to say to her?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, if it were up to me... I'd have you ask her out `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if it were up to me... I'd have you ask her out [color=#3b78e2][i]right now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ask her out... Now?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure... Why not?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oof!
Cameron goes down, with Spencer on top of him!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was for $ALLISON!
Spencer rolls off Cameron and backs away from him.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I probably deserved that for how I've acted with a lot of girls...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: But not for anything I did to $ALLISON.
Cameron gets back up and leans against his locker.
Cameron easily dodges, and Spencer loses his balance, falling to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Easy, man!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I probably deserve to get punched...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: ...but I'm too good-looking to let you mess up my face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is everything a joke to you, Clark?!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Not everything...
Without thinking about it, Spencer makes a half-hearted attempt to hit Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Forget him, okay. He's just mad because it was `his` interceptions that cost us the win on Friday.
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget him, okay. He's just mad because it was [color=#e23b3b][i]his[/i][/color] interceptions that cost us the win on Friday.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. And if I'd actually gotten a chance to play, maybe I could have gotten us the ball back!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is my fault, guys! I'm pretty sure a couple of the linemen were slightly dehydrated.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm demoting myself from `Waterboy` to `Waterbaby.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm demoting myself from [color=#e23b3b][i]Waterboy[/i][/color] to [color=#e23b3b][i]Waterbaby.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't blame yourselves too much, guys. We win as a team. We lose as a team.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That would make a lot more sense if I could actually play...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How close is your leg to healing up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The doctor says I should take it easy for another couple of weeks...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But if I don't play in at least one game this season, I lose my eligibility for the Steelman Program this summer!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't want to risk re-injuring yourself. I'm not gonna tell you what to do...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Then don't tell me what to do!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Then don't tell me what to do![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm already having enough trouble convincing Coach to let me play...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't `you` start doubting me too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] start doubting me too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know I'm on your side, man. No need to be a jerk about it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I just hate sitting around like a chump.
Just then, the guys swim team pours into the locker room, fresh off another victory.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Eleven swim meets... Eleven victories.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's what I call a season.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Enough about swimming, man. I want to hear about your Homecoming date with that redhead.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I think I snuck a peek of you two locking lips.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. It was... An interesting kiss.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Given your level of experience, I'd say it takes a lot for you to consider a kiss 'interesting.'

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Heh. I guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to sit here and listen to this!
Spencer gets up on his crutches.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: To do something stupid!
Spencer heads over toward the swimmers.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, buddy. How's the leg healing up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Say one more thing about $ALLISON. I dare you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You broke her heart!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So... What? You'd prefer it if I were still dating her?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't say that!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why don't you just chill out?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm a calm guy... But my patience is wearing thin.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You want to go?! Let's go right now!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I don't fight guys on crutches...
Spencer throws his crutches to the ground, sending them skittering to Cameron's feet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's your excuse now?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You want to play it that way, huh? Go ahead. Take you best shot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe we would have been better off with you on the bench too, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You threw more picks than touchdowns!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Those statistics are correct! Your quarterback ranking for last Friday's night's game was atrocious!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! What he said!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That... That...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's my receivers' fault!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: With you, it's `always` someone else's fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: With you, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] someone else's fault.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Forget this. I don't need to stand here and take this from a `benchwarmer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget this. I don't need to stand here and take this from a [color=#e23b3b][i]benchwarmer![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nate storms off to the other side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look at you... With your leg broken, you're useless. An inarticulate lump.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know what the word 'inarticulate' means now, creep..

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh... Did your new tutor teach you that one?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, she did!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It means... It means...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sounds like you could use a couple more vocab lessons.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't feel too bad, Spence. Even the best teacher can't help `every` student.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't feel too bad, Spence. Even the best teacher can't help [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] student.

nodes.text: Nate struts off to the other side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hrk!
Spencer breaks through the offensive line, knocking two defenders on their backs!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa! I always knew Spencer was strong, but I didn't know he was `that` strong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! I always knew Spencer was strong, but I didn't know he was [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] strong!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Quite impressive!
Spencer barrels forward toward the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I need more than a sack... I need to strip the ball!
Spencer's at the fifteen...
The ten...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on...
The five...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just a little farther!
Just as he's about to reach the endzone, a defender catches up, crashing into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!
He goes down!
Voices seem to be coming from all around...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! Does this mean we lose?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not even! He went down `in the endzone!` That's a touchdown!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not even! He went down [color=#3b78e2][i]in the endzone![/i][/color] That's a touchdown!

nodes.text: As the crowd cheers, Spencer lies on his back, not moving.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Wait... Is he okay?
A hush falls over the crowd as Spencer's teammate run up to him.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Give him room! Give him room!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spencer! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Please be okay... Please be okay...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wake up, buddy! Wake up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Stop shouting at me. I'm right here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're okay!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... Is the leg...
Spencer gets up and puts some weight on his bad leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A little sore... But it's a small price to pay for a touchdown.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here! I brought you some water!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, E. Just what I needed.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Owwww!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Owwww![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The play ends and Owen runs over from the sideline.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I think `I broke my other leg!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I think [color=#e23b3b][i]I broke my other leg![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As a team of emergency medical staff runs over with a gurney, Spencer knows...
...He has failed.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Can't... Can't go on!
Spencer slows down...
And gets tackled from behind!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!
An hour later, with the game won, and his leg well-iced, Spencer finally walks out of the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There you are!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Red?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I was... Concerned for your health!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The leg is fine.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And your head?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't feel any dumber than usual.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: As your tutor, I refuse to let you speak about yourself in such terms.
She comes close and touches Spencer's hair, examining his head for bruises.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How does that feel?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean fine! I'm not injured!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but I'm glad this barbaric sport is over for the year...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure I could have taken watching you out there every Friday.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks for staying. It means a lot.
Suddenly, $ALLISON wraps Spencer up in a huge hug!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're... Stronger than you look!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd, uh, better get home! My dad's been waiting to drive me home for almost an hour.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm glad you're okay... See you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... See you tomorrow.
$ALLISON walks off toward the parking lot.
As Spencer walks gingerly toward the street, he hears a slow clapping echo from behind him...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Bravo, Spencer. Bravo.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You won the game and the girl.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Nate?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I just wanted to remind you that a deal is a deal...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You took Steelman from me...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And I'll make sure I take $ALLISON away from you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's it, Nate. You asked for this!
Spencer tries to lunge forward and hit Nate...
But when he charges forward, his leg fills with searing pain! Spencer goes down!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You gotta be careful with those sports injuries, buddy. Never know when the might flare up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Say... Whatever you want. I'll warn $ALLISON about you. Whatever you think you're going to do...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Here's the thing, though, Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm smarter than you...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Says you!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not finished.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm smarter than you... `And` I'll do anything it takes to get what I want.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm smarter than you... [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] I'll do anything it takes to get what I want.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And with that, Nate turns and walks off into the darkness...

Spencer picks up the ball and heads for the end zone...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just twenty yards to go...
...But each step is agony. Sharp, stabbing pains course through Spencer's leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gotta... Ignore the pain!
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...
Spencer knocks the ball loose!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The ball's out!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's great... But now he's got to pick up the ball!
Spencer crashes into the quarterback...
And hears a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no! What does that whistle mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Roughing the passer...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means game over...
In the meantime, Spencer writes in pain...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oops!
Spencer trips and falls awkwardly!
Spencer bares down on the opposing quarterback...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: When you snagged the Steelman Program spot away from me, you took away `something I want.`
nodes.text_bbcode: When you snagged the Steelman Program spot away from me, you took away [color=#e23b3b][i]something I want.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And if you don't give it back to me, I'm taking `something you want.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you don't give it back to me, I'm taking [color=#e23b3b][i]something you want.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $ALLISON isn't `something.` She's `someone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color] She's [color=#e23b3b][i]someone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Glad to see those grammar lessons she's giving you are paying off.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Must be pretty tough... Spending all that time so close to a cute girl like that and not making a move.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You stay away from her.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Gladly...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: As long as you don't play tonight.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Otherwise, I `have` been looking for a new girlfriend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Otherwise, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been looking for a new girlfriend.

nodes.text: Spencer curls his hands into fists.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Easy there, Tiger. You don't want to attack your own quarterback right before the big game.
Spencer slams Nate up against a locker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't try to tell me what I want.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fine! Hit me! See what happens!
A small crowd of players is starting to gather.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Better put him down, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're not worth it, Nate.
He lets go of Nate's jersey.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: See you around, Spencer... Say hi to $ALLISON for me.
Nate walks away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow... He really got to you. What did he say?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It was just Nate making stupid threats as usual.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Take it from me... You can't make a deal with guys like that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Once you start, it just gets worse and worse.
Owen's phone beeps again, and he winces.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You gonna tell me who keeps texting you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Someone I made the wrong deal with a long time ago...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Promise you won't let Nate get to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's a promise.
Two hours later, the game is in full-swing. Twin Branches is down 14-17 with only a few minutes left to play.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Coach... Just let me in. I can play on the offensive line, tailback, whatever!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're still recovering. I'm not playing you unless I have to!
Nate jogs onto the field.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Time to go win us the game.
Nate heads out on the field and throws a long pass down toward the endzone...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Here comes the touchdown.
...But his pass gets picked off by the other team!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How is it your fault?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: We need to get the ball back, stat!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Spencer, are you really sure you're fully healed?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes, sir!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're a hundred percent certain you want to play?
For a moment, Spencer looks over to the sidelines, where the girls are cheering on the team.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't let our school be a loser!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Go, Owen! Get in there!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Then you get in there and get us that ball!
Spencer takes a step onto the field, and pain flares from his leg.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ignore the pain, Spencer... This is for Steelman! This is for the win!
Spencer lines up and stares at the opposing quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's go time.
The center hikes the ball to the quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got to get past the offensive line!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I see I've got your attention. Good.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now let me spell this out for you in language even you can understand.
Despite a sudden knot is his gut, Spencer doesn't blink.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who cares what's in your photo?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Apparently you're too stupid to recognize a threat when you see one.

It's Friday, and Spencer is psyching himself up for the last game of the season.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How's it going? Are you `actually` angry or just practicing your angry face?
nodes.text_bbcode: How's it going? Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] angry or just practicing your angry face?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just getting in my zone.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I see you're off crutches for the first time today... Leg feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. But that's not going to keep me out of the game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my zone, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure thing, buddy. Good luck!
Owen leaves, and Spencer slips on his headphones.
He starts listening to some music, pumping himself up...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can do this, Spencer...
The music pulses through him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `You can do this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You can do this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, someone pulls the headphones off of Spencer's ears!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hope I'm not interrupting.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You are, actually.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I just thought we should talk real quick...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm worried about you, Spencer. I don't want you to go out there and get yourself hurt.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More like you don't want me to play so that I lose my spot in the Steelman Program!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I `do` happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] happen to be the first guy on the waiting list...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Honestly, though, lately I've been too preoccupied with my love life to worry about football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't have time to sit around and talk about girls with you!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh, but I'm sure you'll want to talk about this particular girl...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My new friend, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A girl like $ALLISON wouldn't even give you the time of day, creep.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Then why do I have `this photo` on my phone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then why do I have [color=#e23b3b][i]this photo[/i][/color] on my phone?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Then why do I have `this photo` on my phone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then why do I have [color=#e23b3b][i]this photo[/i][/color] on my phone?

nodes.text: Nate takes out his phone... And shows a picture of himself and $ALLISON, cuddled close together!

On the other side of town, Owen is dealing with his own issues...
Well, well, well... The prodigal son returns.
I'm tired of these texts, Sal. I'm tired of you asking for my help.
That's where you've got it wrong, brother. You think I'm `asking.`
One job. One job and whatever I owe you... It's paid.
After that, you leave me and my family alone.
Just one job... And we're going to make it count.
This is going to be fun.
You'd better be as good a driver as they say...
Oh trust me, he is... He is.
And later that night, down at the local arcade...
You want Volume `2` of my cheat sheet for Madame Bovary? No one's ever asked for Volume 2!
Well maybe you've never met someone quite as dedicated to understanding it as I am.
Anything else you want? A few more study guides on Immanuel Kant?
Nate scrolls through files on Dexter's laptop, checking out what's available.
He throws a fifty dollar bill at Dexter.
I'll take this one... This one by Sun Tzu...

nodes.text: On Monday, after football practice, the guys change back to their street clothes in the locker room...

nodes.text: I can't believe this season went by so fast...

nodes.speaker: Erik

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
